verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents a 'flex' service tier for Chat Completions. It is billed at a 20% discount off standard per-token pricing and is positioned for asynchronous workloads such as data enrichment and evaluations. However, it is a per-request, slower-response tier rather than a batch job API where you submit jobs and retrieve results later. Missing for 10: a dedicated asynchronous batch job submission API (job creation, input file upload, status polling, result retrieval), coverage of non-chat endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can submit asynchronous batch inference jobs at a documented discount versus real-time pricing

citations.quote: Flex inference is billed at a 20% discount off the model's standard per-token price.
Set service_tier to "flex" to run Chat Completions requests at a lower cost in exchange for slower response times and occasional resource unavailability.
It’s ideal for non-production or lower-priority tasks such as model evaluations, data enrichment, and asynchronous workloads.
